name: Bahamas

fees.name: Visitor's Visa (eVisa, single entry)
fees.notes: Applied via official MOFA eVisa portal (evisa.mofa.gov.bs); non-refundable. Seaman's visa also USD 160.

fees.name: Multiple entry visa (3 months / 6 months / 1 year)
fees.applies: all nationalities requiring a visa; requires copies of 3 previous successful visas

fees.name: Multiple entry visa (3 years)
fees.notes: Not available via the online portal; apply through a mission.

fees.name: Sponsored Visitor Visa facilitation fee
fees.notes: Facilitation fee in addition to applicable visa fee.

fees.name: Visitor visa via consulate (single entry)
fees.notes: Consulates route applicants to the MOFA eVisa system; same fee schedule. Prices may vary for Bahamian visas issued at British Embassies where the UK represents the Bahamas.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.applies: nationals requiring a visa to transit
fees.notes: No transit visa fee is published on the MOFA eVisa fee schedule; category not listed separately, so amount left null rather than guessed.

vfs.note: No outsourced centre (VFS/TLS/BLS); applications go through the official MOFA eVisa portal or Bahamian missions. Some countries are served by British Embassies, where fees may vary.

free_visa_notes: Many nationalities (e.g. USA, GBR, CAN, EU) are visa-exempt for tourist stays in the Bahamas; fees above apply only to visa-required nationalities. No fee differences by nationality were found on official sources.
